te: According to his own account, Otto von Guericke completes his book Experimenta Nova (ut vocantur) Magdeburgica de Vacuo…
dz: 据奥托·冯·格里克本人记述，他完成了《马格德堡真空新实验》（Experimenta Nova (ut vocantur) Magdeburgica de Vacuo Spatio）一书，详细介绍了真空实验及他对静电斥力的发现。
de: According to his own account, Otto von Guericke completes his book Experimenta Nova (ut vocantur) Magdeburgica de Vacuo Spatio, detailing his experiments on vacuum and his discovery of electrostatic repulsion.

dz: 卡罗来纳省通过特许状授予8名领主,以奖励他们协助英格兰查理二世恢复王位.
de: The Province of Carolina is granted by charter to eight Lords Proprietor in reward for their assistance in restoring Charles II of England to the throne.

t: 葡萄牙在阿迈西亚尔战役中取胜,确保了葡萄牙从西班牙独立.
te: Portuguese victory at the Battle of Ameixial ensures Portugal's independence from Spain.
dz: 葡萄牙恢复战争:葡萄牙在阿迈西亚尔战役中取胜,确保了葡萄牙从西班牙独立.
de: Portuguese Restoration War: Portuguese victory at the Battle of Ameixial ensures Portugal's independence from Spain.

t: 在葡萄牙在阿迈西亚尔战役中取得胜利后,西班牙的埃沃拉驻军投降.
te: The Spanish garrison of Évora capitulates, following the Portuguese victory at the Battle of Ameixial.
dz: 在葡萄牙在阿迈西亚尔战役中取得胜利后,西班牙的埃沃拉驻军投降.
de: The Spanish garrison of Évora capitulates, following the Portuguese victory at the Battle of Ameixial.

te: The English Parliament passes the second Navigation Act requiring that all goods bound for the American colonies have t…
dz: 英国议会通过了第二项"通航法",要求运往美国殖民地的所有货物都必须从英国港口以英国船只来发. 在1707年《联邦法》颁布后,苏格兰将被纳入该法.
de: The English Parliament passes the second Navigation Act requiring that all goods bound for the American colonies have to be sent in English ships from English ports. After the Acts of Union 1707, Scotland would be included in the Act.
